frontPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: sixteen-piece modular game character atlas.
Rebuild the Hearth Levy from reference1 as original modern high-end game art. Reference1 determines identity/clothing; reference2 supplies only modular4x4 layout and rendering quality. He is a hardy citizen defender, distinct from the massive armored Hidewall and royal blue Crown troops.
Adult human man with a serious weathered face, short brown beard and shoulder-length practical dark brown hair beneath a simple close-fitting brown stitched leather cap with small brim. Brown charcoal patchwork sleeveless leather/fur vest with tawny shaggy fur collar over cream linen tunic, crossed worn leather straps, broad rustic belt with pouches, muted brick-red cloth sash hanging at waist, rough split leather hip skirt lined with cream linen, fitted brown trousers, simple brown leather forearm bracers and laced brown leather boots. Modest worn hand-crafted surfaces, no ornate gold, no blue, no plate armor. His axe is RIGHT-handed and round wooden shield LEFT-handed, but NEITHER prop appears in this body atlas.
Premium realistic 3D game sculpture, lifelike adult proportions, tactile original cloth/leather/fur, warm upper-left key with cool bounce. FRONT view, elevated25degree orthographic camera.
Exactly16 isolated pieces, regular4columns×4rows, large fully transparent gutters, no assembled figure.
Row1: head with leather cap, hair and SHORT BARE NECK ONLY, NO collar/fur or torso clothing on the head; torso shoulders-to-waist with vest/fur collar/crossed straps, NO head and NO arm sleeves; belt/pouches/red sash/split hip garment, NO legs; small detached rustic leather utility pouch, unused accessory.
Row2: anatomical LEFT upper arm shoulder-to-elbow ONLY, cream linen sleeve, NO forearm or bracer; RIGHT upper arm same; LEFT forearm elbow-to-wrist with leather bracer, NO hand; RIGHT forearm same.
Row3: LEFT bare closed gripping hand with SHORT bare wrist, no cuff/bracer; RIGHT bare gripping hand same; exactly ONE LEFT trouser thigh hip-to-knee; exactly ONE RIGHT thigh. A single leg tube per cell, never shorts or pairs.
Row4: LEFT trouser shin knee-to-ankle with simple wrap, NO FOOT/BOOT; RIGHT shin same; LEFT separate boot toes facing camera; RIGHT boot toes facing camera.
Arms/legs shafts vertically neutral, no baked elbow/knee bends. Each hand has relaxed curled fingers and small genuinely empty thumb-index shaft opening, no visible wooden stub or weapon. For front view LEFT hand thumb points picture-left, RIGHT hand thumb picture-right. Fingers down, short wrist up.
Torso shoulder areas inside its outline must be continuous underlying cream linen/fur, not a hollow armhole, black socket or bare skin circle. No fixed sleeve stub: separate upper-arm pieces provide the sleeves. Head must not duplicate the fur collar that appears on torso.
No tools, weapons, shield, cargo, cape, scenery, floor, external shadows, text, labels, grid, checkerboard or backgroundcolor. Genuinely transparent PNG RGBA alpha0 between isolated parts.

Asset type: transparent PNG game sprite sheet

Input image: edit target.
Constraints: keep every component and its placement, detail, color, facing direction and size unchanged. Remove only the painted checkerboard background. Preserve clean edges and all gaps. The output is a transparent cutout PNG, not an illustration of cutouts on paper.
